standard.name: AMS2375
standard.title: Control of Forgings Requiring First Article Approval

scope.purpose: Defines first-article and preproduction approval controls for forgings and controls for subsequent production forgings.
scope.application: Used where forgings require preproduction approval and production lots must remain metallurgically consistent with the qualified forging.

forgingStock.conformance: Forging producer verifies stock conforms to applicable material specification and will yield acceptable forgings.
forgingStock.approvedSources: Use cognizant engineering approved stock sources when specified.

preproductionForgings.procedure: Produce and heat treat one or more preproduction forgings using the same practices planned for production.
preproductionForgings.confirmatoryTesting: Submit duplicate or remaining sections to cognizant engineering when requested.
preproductionForgings.nonFinalHeatTreatDelivery: When supplied in other than final heat treated condition, test forging or sections are heat treated to final condition before testing.
preproductionForgings.specimenLocations: Coupon and grain-flow section locations are defined by cognizant engineering; otherwise representative locations require concurrence when required.

properties.grainFlow: Etch representative sections, photograph grain-flow pattern, and verify conformity to drawing without reentrant flow lines or end grains except accepted flash/parting-line end grains.
properties.hardness: Perform hardness surveys across the heaviest section unless otherwise specified.
properties.microstructure: Examine center of heaviest usable section plus surfaces of heaviest and thinnest sections; submit microstructure photos and identify abnormal conditions.
properties.mechanicalProperties: Test representative specimens to the applicable final heat-treated material specification.

processControlFactors: Forging stock type, nominal size, shape, and multiple-weight
Inspection and qualification of forging stock
Processing sequence or number of operations affecting structure, grain flow, or working
Die configuration, dimensions, and forging pressure
Thermal parameters for stock heating, annealing, and heat treatment

productionControl.approvalBeforeShipment: Production forgings are not shipped before written preproduction approval unless waived.
productionControl.changeControl: Changes to design or process-control parameters require cognizant engineering concurrence or reapproval.

records.processInstructions: Maintain documented routing and processing methods for each part number or configuration.

reports: Test results showing conformance to AMS2375, material specification, and drawing

systemUse.primaryUse: Reference/process-control standard for forging FAI workflows.
systemUse.autoFillImpact: Should not drive UT scan parameters or acceptance criteria directly; use alongside the active UT standard for forged aerospace parts.
